verdict.rationale: Open Finance is API-first. The core product functions are documented as API endpoints: account ownership, balances, ACH details, transactions, data refresh, reports and insights (docs-1, -2, -7, -15, -32, -13, -22). Token generation is programmatic (docs-23), and OBWMS provides an API for subscribing to webhook events (docs-26). However, linking accounts requires the Connect UI flow (docs-27), and project and client creation is described as portal UI steps (docs-35), so full UI-to-API parity is not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API-based project/app onboarding and management, a programmatic alternative to the Connect linking flow, and independent corroboration.
